response.justification: Technically a strong, versatile senior engineer with 15+ years across web, embedded, high-throughput backends and a self-founded open-source geo-data platform, plus genuine Linux/open-source credibility and a CS degree. However, the profile is that of a hands-on individual contributor and community educator, not a development lead: there is no evidence of formal team leadership, line management, technical project management, client-facing architecture consulting, or IT security/risk/compliance work. Critically, German is listed as 'Basic' against a hard C1 minimum for a role that involves advising German clients on architecture and digital sovereignty — this alone is likely disqualifying. UML/modeling and Python are also absent from the stated skill set.
strengths: 15+ years of broad, deep hands-on engineering across many stacks and domains
Strong open-source/Linux orientation, incl. founding and running an OSS platform
Proven knowledge-sharing ability (workshops, talks, courses) suggesting mentoring potential
concerns: German listed as 'Basic' vs. required C1 — likely a hard blocker
No demonstrated team leadership, people management, or project-management ownership
No evidence of UML/modeling, requirements management, or IT security/compliance experience

key_factors.factor: Lack of leadership / technical project management track record
Deep senior engineering and open-source/Linux experience
